name: I-eczema
tagline: Ulusu olurhawuzelayo, olomileyo. Ukufuma. Lawula izichukumisi.

what_is_it.heading: Eczema ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-eczema (ekwabizwa ngokuba yi-atopic dermatitis) yimeko yesikhumba yexesha elide apho umqobo wolusu ungabambeli kakuhle ukufuma kwaye ucaphuka lula. Isiphumo: omile, ukurhawuzelelwa, iipatches ezivuthayo - ngamanye amaxesha zivutha kakubi, ngamanye amaxesha zizolile.
paragraphs: I-eczema idla ngokuqala ebuntwaneni - malunga nomntwana om-1 kwabahlanu eMzantsi Afrika unayo. Abaninzi baphucula ngokukhula, nangona inokubuya nangaliphi na ixesha. I-eczema yabantu abadala nayo ixhaphakile. Ihlala ihamba ecaleni kwesifuba, ihay fever, okanye iallergies ekutyeni - 'atopic triad'.

I-eczema ayosuleli. Ayibangelwa kukungcola okanye ukungacoceki. Isithintelo solusu kwi-eczema sihluke nje ngokwemfuza - i-porous ngakumbi, isebenza ngakumbi. Iindaba ezilungileyo: ngokuthambisa imihla ngemihla kunye nolawulo lwe-trigger, abantu abaninzi bayigcina ilawulwa kakuhle.

items.headline: 1 ku5
items.body: Abantwana baseMzantsi Afrika bane-eczema. Abaninzi bayaphucuka ngokukhula. I-eczema yabantu abadala ixhaphakile nayo.

items.headline: I-Moisturizer iphumelele
items.body: Ukuthambisa imihla ngemihla - nokuba ulusu lukhangeleka lulungile - lolona nyango lunamandla lwe-eczema. Tsiba iintsuku ezimbalwa kwaye umlilo uyabuya.

items.headline: Ayosuleli
items.body: Awukwazi ukubamba i-eczema. Ayibangelwa bukungcola okanye ucoceko. Ngumba wothintelo lwemfuzo lwesikhumba, rhoqo kunye nelungu le-aleji.

items.headline: I-steroid creams iyasebenza
items.body: I-Topical steroids ngexesha lokuvutha zikhuselekile xa zisetyenziswe ngokuchanekileyo. Bazolisa ukuvuvukala ukuze ulusu luphole.

pull_quote.text: Uninzi lwe-eczema lulawulwa kakuhle ngamanyathelo amabini alula: thambisa kabini ngosuku yonke imihla, kwaye usebenzise i-steroid cream xa ivutha. Impazamo eyenziwa ngabantu abaninzi kukumisa i-moisturizer xa ulusu lubonakala lulungile.

signs.heading: Ibukeka njani i-eczema
signs.lede: I-eczema ibonakala kwiindawo eziqhelekileyo kwaye ineepateni eziqhelekileyo. Inkangeleko inokwahluka kwiitoni zolusu ezahlukeneyo-kwisikhumba esimnyama sinokuvela ngwevu, mfusa, okanye mnyama mdaka kunencwadi ebomvu.

items.title: Iintsana kunye nabantwana abancinci
items.description: Izidlele, isikhumba sentloko, kunye neengalo nemilenze yangaphandle. Ubomvu (okanye umnyama, kwisikhumba esiMnyama), owomileyo, amabala ahlala e-crusty. Kuyarhawuzelelwa kakhulu - abantwana bayarhawuzelela naxa belele.

items.title: Abantwana abadala kunye nabantu abadala
items.description: Ukugoba kwesikhumba - ngaphakathi kweengqiniba, ngasemva kwamadolo, izihlahla, intamo, amaqatha. Amabala olusu olujiyileyo, olunexolo, olurhawuzelelwa. Izandla kunye neenkophe eziqhelekileyo kubantu abadala.

items.title: Ngexesha lokukhathazeka - usulelo
items.description: Ukuba amabala ayalila, abe tyheli, abe buhlungu kakhulu, okanye asasazeke ngokukhawuleza - inokosuleleka. Ifuna uvavanyo lweklinikhi malunga ne-antibiotics okanye unyango lwe-antiviral.

items.fact: Isetyenziswe ngokuchanekileyo kwiikhosi ezimfutshane ngexesha lokuvutha, i-topical steroids ikhuselekile kwaye iyasebenza. Ukuziphepha kubangela ingozi enkulu - i-eczema engapheliyo engalawulekiyo yenza ulusu lube lukhuni kwaye lubangele usulelo.

I-allergies yokutya yokwenyani ibangela i-eczema kwabanye abantwana - kodwa uninzi lwe-eczema ayiqhutywa kukutya. Gwema ukutya okuphelisa ngaphandle kweengcebiso zonyango; zinokubangela ingozi yokwenyani kwisondlo.

Ukukrwempa kuwonakalisa ngakumbi umqobo wolusu, kukhuphe iikhemikhali zokurhawuzelelwa ngakumbi, kwaye kudala umjikelo okhohlakeleyo wokurhawuzelelwa. Ukucinezela okubandayo, ukuthambisa, kunye ne-antihistamines kuyanceda - ukukrwela akuncedi.

Abaninzi bayayenza, kodwa abaninzi abakwenzi oko. Kwanabo 'bakhulileyo' banokuba namadangatye xa sele bekhulile. Imikhwa yokukhathalela ulusu ubomi bonke - izicoci ezithambileyo, i-moisturizer yemihla ngemihla - kufanelekile ukwakha kwangoko.

prevention.heading: Imikhwa yemihla ngemihla egcina ukuvutha kude
prevention.lede: Ulawulo lwe-eczema lumalunga nokhathalelo lwemihla ngemihla yolusu - imikhwa emincinci ethintela ukugqabhuka okulandelayo.

items.title: Moisturise kabini ngemini, yonke imihla
items.description: Isithambiso esingqindilili esingenavumba lokuthambisa kwimizuzu emi-3 yokuvasa emanzini. Qhubeka nokuba ulusu lukhangeleka lulungile - oku kukuthintela ukugqabhuka okulandelayo.

items.title: Iibhafu ezimfutshane ezishushu okanye iishawari
items.description: Amanzi ashushu ahluba ulusu. Sebenzisa amanzi adikidiki, angenavumba elimnandi (hayi isepha eqhelekileyo), imizuzu emi-5 ukuya kweli-10 ubuninzi. Yomisa kancinci — sukuhlikihla.

items.title: Yazi kwaye uphephe izinto ezikubangelayo
items.description: Izinto eziqhelekileyo ezibangela: ukushisa kunye nokujuluka, uboya kunye neendwangu zokwenziwa, iisepha ezinobunzima kunye ne-detergents, uxinzelelo, izifo (izilwanyana ezifuywayo, uthuli). Gcina idayari ye-flare ukuze ubone eyakho.

items.title: Igumbi lokulala elipholileyo, elizolileyo
items.description: Ubushushu kunye nokubila kuye kube mandundu xa ukurhawuzelelwa ebusuku. Gcina igumbi lokulala lipholile, sebenzisa amashiti e-cotton, kwaye ungafaki kakhulu abantwana. Isipholileyo sizolile.

items.title: Faka i-steroid cream kwi-flare esebenzayo
items.description: Ifumaneka kwiiklinikhi - idla ngokuba yi-hydrocortisone (ephakathi) ebusweni nakwiintsana, yomelele emzimbeni. Sebenzisa kancinci kwiipatches ezibomvu kabini ngemini de uzolile. Yima ke.

items.title: Gcina ufumile - nangaphezulu kwe-steroid
items.description: Faka isicelo sokuthambisa imizuzu engama-30 emva kwe-steroid, okanye ngamanye amaxesha. I-moisturizer ixhasa ukuphilisa - ungayeki kuba usebenzisa i-steroid.

items.title: Thatha i-antihistamine xa urhawuzelela kakhulu
items.description: I-Cetirizine okanye i-loratadine inceda ngokubetha, ngakumbi ebusuku. Ifumaneka kwikhawuntara kuyo nayiphi na ikhemesti. Ingakumbi luncedo kubantwana abakrwempa ebuthongweni babo.

items.title: Ukuba ulusu luyakhala okanye losuleleke - yiya ekliniki
items.description: I-Yellow crusting, intlungu esasazekayo, umkhuhlane - unokuba lusulelo lwebhaktheriya (i-staph) okanye i-eczema herpeticum (intsholongwane, eyingozi kakhulu). Ifuna unyango ngokukhawuleza.

items.title: Kwi-eczema enzima okanye enzima ukuyilawula
items.description: Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zinokubhekisa kugqirha wesikhumba. Unyango olutsha olufana ne-dupilumab (inaliti yebhayoloji) iguqule i-eczema enzima kwiminyaka yakutshanje.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lwe-eczema lulawulwa kakuhle kwinqanaba lekliniki. Iimeko ezimandundu ziyazuza ekuthunyelweni kwe-dermatology - ifumaneka ngenkqubo yoluntu.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwasimahla lwe-eczema, izinto zokuthambisa, kunye ne-steroid creams
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo
